Instructions: HOW TO USE THIS RFO
MIRC Request For Orders - interactive Excel version (no macros). Built for Excel for Windows / Microsoft 365 (also opens in Excel for Mac and Excel for the web).
Quick start
1. Go to the RFO Form tab. White boxes are type-in, light-gold boxes are dropdowns, blue-gray cells fill themselves in (locked). * = required.
2. Work the ASSIGNMENT block top to bottom: ① Create Temp Assignment → ② Trans Type → ③ Subtrans → ④ Duty Purpose. ⑤ UDL and ⑥ Unit (DTS LOA) fill in by themselves.
If the UDL funds more than one unit (e.g. Annual Training has 11), pick the FUNDING UNIT in the box right under ⑥ - the status panel will remind you.

Start date: pick Month / Day / Year (desktop Excel has no built-in pop-up calendar without macros). The mini calendar under the status panel shows the start (navy), days on orders (blue) and end (orange).

SOLDIER'S UIC: pick from the MIRC UIC list or just type the UIC. The unit and BDE show right next to it, and for multi-unit UDLs (e.g. Annual Training) the funding unit fills itself in from the Soldier's BDE when that match is clear.
Hover/click any field for a tip. Press Tab to jump from one fill-in cell to the next (the sheet is protected, so Tab skips the calculated cells).

Pick NUMBER OF DAYS (1-365); END DATE = start + days - 1. From/To City: pick 'City, ST' from the list or type any place as 'Place, ST' - the STATE next to it fills itself in (amber note if there's no ', ST').
Each dropdown only shows what's valid for the picks above it. Example: ① Annual Training - TPU leaves only 'AT - CMD Funded' in ②.

3. ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS follows the v8 IPPS-A Assignment Decision Tree lane by lane (01 Route → 09 Admin). Answer each decision question (YES / NO etc.) - the code, or the next question, shows at right. Gray = not on your path.

Panels (e.g. AIRLINE TICKETING / GTCC / CBA / IBA) are pick lists with only that panel's tree codes. Once you pick a code, duplicates and codes the tree says conflict with it drop out of the other lists.
4. Watch the RFO STATUS panel on the right. It says READY TO SUBMIT when nothing's left, otherwise it lists exactly what to fix.
5. 'CODES TO TOGGLE IN IPPS-A' (row 123) is the sorted list of every Additional Instruction code your answers and picks add - switch those on in IPPS-A.
When a cell turns red
• You changed something upstream and this value doesn't fit anymore. Excel can't clear it without macros, so it flags it. Click the arrow and repick (or hit Delete).
• An Additional Instructions answer or pick is red when it's off your path on the tree (clear it), is a duplicate, or conflicts with another code per the tree. The status panel says which.
Conflicts and cross-checks

• Additional Instructions only enforces conflicts the tree states (e.g. 11/12/13 pick one, 27 vs 68, HHG YES codes vs 43, 196 vs 244). No required pairs - the tree tags its 'requires' links (17 → 247) INFERRED.
• Moved in the past 30 days = YES needs a new address; Continuation Order = YES needs the previous order #; Variation = YES needs the FROM / TO city.
After you submit in IPPS-A (from the FY27 Reference Sheet navigation cues)
1. After selecting the Duty Position, click Continue at the top of the page.
2. In Addl Instructions, toggle on every instruction that applies (use the CODES TO TOGGLE line).
3. Back at the top, set Discretionary Election Status to Complete.
4. Copy the Assignment ID for your records, then click Submit.
Pending Approval = Pending/Working tab; Approved = Current/Approved tab under Manage Assignments.
Save as PDF and sign with CAC
• PDF: File › Save As › PDF (Options… › Active sheet), or File › Print › Microsoft Print to PDF.

• Signature lines (manual): Review › Unprotect Sheet. Click the OIC/NCOIC Signature box › Insert › Text › Signature Line (Microsoft Office Signature Line). Suggested signer = the approver's name, Title = OIC/NCOIC, untick 'Allow the signer to add comments in the Sign dialog', keep 'Show sign date' › OK. Drag/resize it onto the Signature box. Repeat for 1SG/CDR. Protect the sheet again (no password).
• (The macro-enabled copy MIRC_RFO_Interactive.xlsm does all of that with one button.)
• To sign: double-click your signature line › Select Certificate / Change › pick the CAC certificate for DIGITAL SIGNATURE (not encryption) › Sign › CAC PIN.
• Sign only when the RFO is final. A signed workbook is marked final/read-only, and any later edit removes every signature.
1-page summary

• The 'RFO Summary' tab (right after the form) is a live, condensed copy of the form on ONE printed page: Soldier, assignment / funding, dates, route, the Additional Instruction codes with their text, RFO STATUS and small approval lines. Empty fields are left out.

• Open it with 📋 GO TO 1-PAGE SUMMARY (status panel, or under the form) or the tab. Print: File › Print - Settings already say 1 page (Fit Sheet on One Page). PDF: File › Save As › PDF › Options… › 'Active sheet' › Save (or print to Microsoft Print to PDF).
• Up to 36 codes are listed with their text; if there are more, the last line says how many more and points to CODES TO TOGGLE on the form.
Cost estimate (ESTIMATE ONLY - not an official entitlement determination)

• Under the form (below the feedback block; the 💲 link in the status panel jumps there) is the COST ESTIMATE. It uses RANK, START DATE, NUMBER OF DAYS and the Route (lane 01) from the form, plus a few extra inputs: prior enlisted service (O-1E to O-3E), PEBD or YEARS OF SERVICE, DEPENDENTS, DUTY ZIP, optional HOME ZIP, BAH TYPE, PER DIEM, government lodging / meals, round-trip POV miles and FICA.

• Math (reserve active-duty orders): basic pay, BAH and BAS = monthly rate ÷ 30 × days. BAH: 30 days or fewer = BAH RC/T (Type II); 31+ days = locality BAH for the home ZIP (duty ZIP if blank). FICA = 6.2% + 1.45% of basic pay (employer share in the total; the employee share is shown for info). Per diem (route 12 or PER DIEM = YES): lodging × (days - 1) nights at the start month's GSA rate + M&IE with first / last day at 75%. Mileage = miles × GSA / JTR POV rate.

• Rates: DFAS basic pay + BAS (1 Jan 2026), DTMO BAH 2026 + non-locality RC/T, GSA per diem FY2026 + FY2027, SSA FICA 2026 / 2027, GSA POV 2026. The year comes from the START DATE (per diem by federal fiscal year). Tables that aren't published yet (2027 pay, BAS, BAH, POV) are blank; the estimate then uses the latest year and shows an amber ⚠ flag.

• Red estimate input = needed and missing (YOS, DEPENDENTS, DUTY ZIP) or not a 5-digit ZIP. The estimate never changes RFO STATUS. OCONUS, COLA, special pays and JTR long-term (flat-rate) per diem are not modeled.

• Updating rates each year: right-click any tab › Unhide › 'Rates' - and follow the HOW TO UPDATE steps at the top of it (paste the new year's DFAS / DTMO / GSA rows; the sources and effective dates are listed there too).
Feedback (helps the RFO owner improve this form)

• Under the form is a FEEDBACK block that doesn't print: pick 👍 This form was useful? (YES / NO) and a RATING (1-5), and type comments and a suggested improvement. Save and send the file back to the RFO owner.
• The one-click logging buttons (👍 / GIVE FEEDBACK) and the usage counters need the macro-enabled MIRC_RFO_Interactive.xlsm.
Other tabs
• Matrix: every allowed cascade path, the tree's Additional Instructions conflicts, and the tree rules that are tagged INFERRED (not enforced).
• Code Matrix: every tree question / panel → code, plus the conflict grid.
• Rules: every rule with its source, plus the tree gaps (things the tree is silent on, left out) and what was removed. Amber = inferred - worth a quick sanity check.
• FY27 IPPS-A Reference Sheet: the original reference, untouched.

• SOLDIER'S UIC list: unhide Lists, columns BJ (UIC), BK (unit), BN (BDE). Add new UICs at the bottom (room to row 1001) - the dropdown and funding-unit match pick them up. BQ = '-' stops a UIC from auto-filling the funding unit; any other BQ value forces that REF unit name (e.g. 'TSC - EUC').

• Lists and AI_Engine (hidden): the helper tables. AI_Engine A:C = each tree panel's options, H:I = the tree conflict pairs. Unhide them (right-click any tab → Unhide) to look under the hood. 'Feedback Log' and 'Admin Dashboard' are hidden the same way.
Notes
• The RFO Form sheet is protected with NO password so formulas don't get overwritten. Review → Unprotect Sheet if you need to change the layout, then Protect Sheet again (leave the password blank).

• Printing: the print area is the form only (column B to K), portrait, 1 page wide (3 pages: header + assignment, lanes 01-04, lanes 05-09 + approvals), with page / date footer. The status panel and calendar don't print.
• Pasting into a dropdown cell skips Excel's validation. The red flags and status panel still catch it.
• Verify codes against the current JTR / unit SOP before submitting. This tool helps you avoid mistakes. It doesn't replace that check.
Rules: RULES - every rule the form enforces, with its source

Basis: STATED / TREE = written in a source doc (TREE = v8 decision tree, green) · INFERRED = my reading (amber) · TREE-INFERRED = the tree tags it INFERRED, so NOT enforced (amber) · GAP = tree is silent, left out (pink) · REMOVED = gone in change set 3 (gray) · USER-APPROVED = tree-INFERRED rule Jeovanie approved, enforced (blue)

① Create Temporary Assignment options = the 4 assignment types on the FY27 IPPS-A Reference Sheet (Annual Training - TPU, ADTS - TPU, ADT - TPU, ADOS-RC - TPU). Row 17 (1B PRID IDT TRP) is all N/A, so it isn't offered.
② TRANS TYPE only lists trans types that appear on a REF row with the chosen assignment (e.g. Annual Training - TPU -> AT - CMD Funded only).

Where a REF cell lists two assignments / two trans types / several DPCs, they're paired line-by-line by name: ADT - TPU <-> 0170 ADT - CMD Funded <-> DPCs ending '- OTD' or '- ADT'; ADOS-RC - TPU <-> 0166 ADOS-RC - CMD Funded <-> DPCs ending '- ADOS'.
AT: 0136 Individual <-> INDIV AT and 0133 Unit <-> UNIT AT.

VTER (Anti-Terrorism): REF shows ADT - TPU and ADOS-RC - TPU plus an '- ADOS' DPC, but only '0170 ADT - CMD Funded' as trans type. The form also offers ADOS-RC - TPU -> 0166 -> 0174 -> ANTI-TERRORISM - ADOS so that DPC is reachable.

③ SUBTRANS TYPE lists subtrans types on REF rows matching ① + ②; ④ DPC lists DPCs matching ① + ② + ③. ⑤ ROUTING / MDEP UDL fills in automatically = REF col Q for the matching row (every DPC maps to exactly one UDL).

⑥ UNIT (DTS LOA) fills in automatically when the program has one funding unit (REF col C / col T). When the program funds 2+ units (PRAT 11, GPIR 12, PRSA 7, TRCD OP TRN 9) the REF sheet doesn't say which one applies, so the FUNDING UNIT dropdown asks for it (only those units are listed).
REF cols C, R, S, T
DTS LOA shown = Officer LOA (col S) for WO1-CW5 and 2LT-MG, Enlisted LOA (col R) otherwise.
REF cols R/S headers; warrant officers -> Officer LOA is inferred
PRSA rows 44 and 52 share subtrans 0158; the DPC picks the program (ARMY MED COMP - ADOS -> MEDICAL ADOS / PRSA MED LOA).
